author: matchingplaid
body: To be honest, I don't think beo hydrus is built for raids. I think you're better off using the auriga for raids and the hydrus for something like pvp, or i find it good for tower and horde dungeons with a good arisen qatvanga

author: machumpo
body: I'd be curious too, I just switch to Auriga for raids :)  Best I've come up with is a hybrid build with a pet and gear so I get both T.All\^\^\^ and. T.Mag\^\^\^ which does some steady damage but is not nearly as quick as Auriga and the big nukes.

author: rahulabon
body:
For BeoH on raids I use an ultima strikes build, but honestly BeoA with ASG is quicker and more safe. 

With the % block on Kingdom raids I can run though with the ultima strikes build with little issues, but need to be more mindful with Morri and have to actually use ward.

author: KevineCove
body: Why do you want to raid with BeoH? I main BeoH and even I switch to Auriga for raiding.

author: petr1petr
body:
I main beoH - when I am too lazy to switch, I raid with spiked shield - but it is so slow - so I rather switch to beoA/Chronomancer - fastes and safest raiding I have ever done.

However, if you insist - go with spiked shield - kind of slow, but pretty safe..

author: [deleted]
body:
with less than 20 AL, a deific-buff giving pet, Aaru's bathrobe of great concentration (event), and a celestial wand of either selene or prom hands, I do raid as BeoH, and it is very safe and fast for the first 30% of hp. Accessories are open for immunities, head/feet for pet act or mag or immunity, offhand can be a shield or a second lute, w/e. 

Almost always buff mag 1, 2, gol, woo, wyrm, brynhild then blast away for 2mins at 300-750k per hit. Not the fastest but it works and I rarely mess w/ gear or class.
